name: en-long-03-london-trip
input: we arrive in london at seven forty five on saturday morning the hotel is on baker street and costs one hundred and twenty pounds a night after check in we are going to the british museum which opens at ten the tickets are free but we booked a guided tour for thirty five pounds per person in the evening we have a table at a restaurant in soho at eight on sunday we take the train to oxford at nine fifteen and come back late
reference: We arrive in London at 7:45 on Saturday morning. The hotel is on Baker Street and costs £120 a night. After check-in we are going to the British Museum, which opens at 10. The tickets are free, but we booked a guided tour for £35 per person. In the evening we have a table at a restaurant in Soho at 8. On Sunday we take the train to Oxford at 9:15 and come back late.
